question: True or false: when working adults were paged at random, flow turned up more often at work than in free time?
answer: True. Csikszentmihalyi and LeFevre paged workers at random moments for a week. Flow, high challenge met by high skill, appeared in 54% of reports from work and 18% of those from leisure, much of which went on television. Yet at work people more often said they wished to be doing something else.
move: Where a feeling was first studied is not where it mostly happens.
trap: Picturing flow as climbers and chess players, the cases first studied.
reference: Csikszentmihalyi & LeFevre, Optimal experience in work and leisure, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 1989
